sources.snippet: A champion snapshot is an accepted canonical parent (see Model Originality & Derivative Submissions in the OpenRoboto docs). Always pin the commit, never main — main moves every time the champion changes:

sources.title: OpenRoboto — Robot intelligence built in the open
sources.snippet: An open competition on Bittensor for continuously improving robotics models. Fine-tune the base model, submit your weights on-chain, and the best model becomes the next base.

sources.title: GitHub - bittensor2x/openroboto
sources.snippet: Automated submit pipeline for Bittensor subnet OpenRoboto (SN80). Queue a model from Telegram → download → permute (Gemma FFN shuffle) → upload to Hugging Face as {user}/pi05- {hotkey_ss58 [-12:]} → ask → publicize → burn the evaluation fee and announce on-chain.
